method: six inline source review passes; no tests/compilation/runtime probes

findings.finding: Approved input could be replaced under the same claim context
findings.resolution: Controller now privately pins inputHash/projectId; full approved metadata and actual tree are verified.

findings.finding: Whole-file hashes alone did not prove underlying chunk/packed-object consistency
findings.resolution: Reconstruct every referenced data object from actual readonly file ranges and check its SHA; cap metadata and per-segment memory.

findings.finding: No concrete physical staging or mandatory launch binding
findings.resolution: Supplied create-only root assembler, exact byte/tree acceptance, private staging receipt and fresh guard held through stop.

findings.finding: New readonly input image conflicted with native same-device admission
findings.resolution: Native input now requires its own root-mounted readonly volume; all children stay on its pinned device.

findings.finding: Stop proof was structural and lacked start/output provenance
findings.resolution: Private positive-stop binding includes actual startup, plan/job/helper and opened output identity; JSON/PID/guest exit cannot authorize intake.
Root helper copies exact expected raw bytes before readonly mounting, sanitizes bounded envelope, rehashes raw copy and seals final image.

findings.finding: Empty bundles and executable file modes were lost
findings.resolution: Guest result v2 records directories/modes; collector preserves empty directories and 0555 executable content; host independently checks both.

findings.finding: Guard rejection could leave later asynchronous activation/publication running
findings.resolution: Internal abort propagation cancels pending operations; public stop includes guard postflight; no late success promotion.

findings.finding: Separate accepted result handles could publish the same intake twice
findings.resolution: One-shot publication latch belongs to the shared request, set before awaited work; ambiguous writes remain retained.

findings.finding: Default guard lifetime was shorter than a long job
findings.resolution: Stage launch requires timeout plus two-minute margin; configurable guard upper bound65min.

findings.finding: Darwin ACL removal sentinel was initially wrong in the new Python binding
findings.resolution: Read installed SDK declarations; use FILESEC_ACL5, ACL_FIRST_ENTRY0, sentinel1 and explicit ctypes prototypes.

findings.finding: Staging byte/host bounds and authority-success wording needed alignment
findings.resolution: Admit job/provenance overhead; align TS/native disk/RAM/UID limits; publication returns claim only and does not release quarantine.

open.finding: Production RuntimeAdapter/controller, lease during IO, guest census, authority stage/verification and reconciliation are not wired.
Generic writable CAS/materialization seal and inherited integration HOLD remain.
C/Swift/Python ABI, compilation, disk-image and readonly mount behavior, VZ lifecycle and provider/recovery acceptance have not been executed.
